# How many employees does Pack have?

Pack SRL has approximately84 total employees worldwide as ofJune 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.Pack’s total headcount has grown117.1% from 39 employees in 2023 to 84 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is Pack hiring right now?

Yes, Pack isactively hiring. Pack had6 active job postings in 2026, a 200.0% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/pack/employees#postings).

## About Pack’s Workforce

Pack SRL is an Information Technology Services company that employs **84** people worldwide as of June 2026. It is the 11th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/pack/employees#similar-companies). Founded in 2022, the company is headquartered in Bologna, Italy.

Pack's workforce has grown **117.1%** from 2023 to 2026, up **20.7%** year over year in 2026. It fell to a low of **37** in 2023 Q4 before recovering. Its workforce is concentrated most in Southern Europe ( **86.7%**), followed by Northern Europe ( **4.2%**) and Western Europe ( **3.1%**).

Pack's functional groups are Finance and Operations ( **43.6%**), Engineering ( **42.3%**), and Sales and Marketing ( **14.1%**), with Sales and Marketing growing fastest (up **36.6%**). The average salary is **$62,950,** ranging from a median of **$71,000** in Northern Europe to **$48,000** in Southern Europe, up **10.2%** year over year in 2026.

Pack's active job postings rose **200.0%** in 2026 to **6**, with new postings per month climbing from **2** in 2023 to **8** in 2026. Overall employee sentiment is positive but declining.
